ambiguities.text: The specification states 'any operation that causes the transaction or top-level call to revert' triggers status 0, but does not explicitly define all revert conditions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume revert conditions include: REVERT opcode, out-of-gas, invalid opcode, stack underflow/overflow, and any other EVM exception.

ambiguities.text: The exact byte position and encoding of the status field within the RLP-encoded receipt is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume status replaces state root at the same position in the RLP structure, as a single byte (0x00 or 0x01).

implicit_assumptions.description: Block producers correctly set the status code based on actual execution outcome.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect status codes could cause applications to incorrectly interpret transaction outcomes, leading to financial losses.

implicit_assumptions.description: The intermediate state root was already unused due to EIP-98, so removing it has no practical impact.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If any tooling or contracts relied on the state root, they would break at the Byzantium fork.

implicit_assumptions.description: All clients and tooling will be updated to interpret the new receipt format correctly.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Tools expecting the old format might misparse receipts, leading to incorrect transaction status reporting.
